# MainStay Suites Texas Medical Center / Reliant Park

> Extended stay hotel at 3134 Old Spanish Trail, Houston, Texas 77054, under
> two miles from the Texas Medical Center and MD Anderson. All eighteen room
> types have a kitchen. Free weekday shuttle within three miles. Franchised
> property of Choice Hotels International, property code TX933.

## Booking

Reservations are taken on choicehotels.com, not on this site.
Availability and current rates: https://www.choicehotels.com/texas/houston/mainstay-hotels/tx933/rates
Front desk, open 24 hours: (832) 201-3131

## Key facts

- Address: 3134 Old Spanish Trail, Houston, TX 77054
- Distance to the Texas Medical Center and MD Anderson: under 2 miles
- Shuttle: free, Monday to Friday 7:00 am to 7:00 pm, three-mile radius
- Kitchens: full-size refrigerator, cooktop, microwave, dishes, in every suite
- Check in 3:00 pm, check out 11:00 am
- Parking: free, on site, truck parking available
- Guest laundry on site, outdoor pool, fitness room
- Weekly rates from seven nights
- Texas exempts stays of 30 or more consecutive days from hotel occupancy tax
- Five accessible rooms, wheelchair and hearing
- Smoke free. Pets not permitted; service animals welcome at no charge
- Deposit: $100 card hold, refunded at checkout
